entries.root_cause: A broad rewrite of the shared adversarial-learning falsifier preserved invocation of the historical Wave 4 authorization guard but removed the assertions that proved authorization scope used an exact path allowlist rather than prefixes. The credited guardrail could therefore remain callable while its historical invariant disappeared.

The same shared assurance rewrite reduced the Wave 4 source-authority TOCTOU guard to self-invocation liveness and removed its cross-artifact assertions for the authoritative source-row lock, pinned PostgreSQL race proof, and validator requirement. Historical concurrency safety could therefore regress while learning reconciliation stayed green.

entries.root_cause: The AI-E2E generic raw-HTML recognizer used a character class that rejected angle brackets inside quoted attribute values even though GitHub-flavored Markdown permits them in complete type-7 HTML tags. Hidden canonical headings could therefore be treated as rendered governance structure.

The AI-E2E validator applied semantic Markdown visibility filtering to canonical headings but still searched raw document bytes for required normative prose. A required rule could therefore be moved into an HTML comment, fenced code, or raw HTML while contradictory rendered prose replaced it and exact-head governance would still pass.

The manifest schema-version check relied on Python equality only. Because bool is a subclass of int and True == 1, JSON true was accepted as schema version 1, allowing a machine-readable contract to advertise the wrong JSON type while governance reported success.
